---
description: "Pick a stop to see its recent departures against the timetable, and open any trip to see how it ran stop by stop."
title: "Stops and trips"
subtitle: "Every departure from a timetable stop over the last 28 days with service"
---

Pick a stop to see each departure from it, how far from the timetable it
was, and how we knew. Pick one of its trips to follow that bus stop by
stop. Times are in Pacific time; a dash means we could not time that
departure. To watch every bus move over a whole day, see
[Replay a day](replay.qmd).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import {json, pct, count, longDate, lateness, emptyNote, guard, h} from "./lib.js"
import {makeCharts} from "./charts.js"
import {Plot} from "./vendor/plot-0.6.11/plot.js"
ch = makeCharts({Plot})
index = json("data/views/stops/index.json")
stopList = (index?.stops ?? []).filter(s => s && s.stop_id)
fromHash = () => decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1))
SOURCES = ({own: "the trip's own reports", borrowed_before: "the bus before it showed this trip",
  borrowed_after: "the bus after it stopped showing this trip", borrowed_within: "the bus while it showed no trip"})
RESULTS = ({on_time: "on time", early: "early", late: "late", gap: "no time: a gap in the bus's reports",
  not_reached: "no time: tracking ended first", past_when_first_seen: "no time: the bus was past it when first seen",
  no_reports: "no time: no reports for this trip", skipped: "no time: the bus left out this part of the route",
  unplaced: "no time: the stop is off the route's line"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof stopId = {
  if (stopList.length === 0) return Object.assign(emptyNote("unavailable", "The list of stops"), {value: null});
  const wanted = fromHash();
  const start = stopList.some(s => s.stop_id === wanted) ? wanted : stopList[0].stop_id;
  const select = h("select", {id: "stop-pick"}, ...stopList.map(s =>
    h("option", {value: s.stop_id, selected: s.stop_id === start ? "" : null}, `${s.name} (routes ${s.routes.length})`)));
  const label = h("label", {for: "stop-pick", class: "picker-label"}, "Stop");
  const box = h("div", {class: "picker route-picker"}, label, select);
  box.value = start;
  select.addEventListener("change", () => {
    box.value = select.value;
    history.replaceState(history.state, "", `#${encodeURIComponent(select.value)}`);
    box.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  });
  return box;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
stop = stopId ? json(`data/views/stops/${encodeURIComponent(stopId)}.json`) : null
info = stopList.find(s => s.stop_id === stopId) ?? null
cols = index?.columns ?? []
rows = (stop?.rows ?? []).map(r => Object.fromEntries(cols.map((c, i) => [c, r[i]])))
  .map(r => ({...r, date: new Date(`${r.service_date}T12:00:00Z`)}))
```

::: {.slot-chart}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
guard(() => {
  if (!info) return emptyNote("unavailable", "This stop");
  const timed = rows.filter(r => r.minutes_late != null);
  const onTime = timed.filter(r => r.result === "on_time").length;
  const say = timed.length ? `${pct(onTime / timed.length)} of the ${count(timed.length)} departures we could time were on time; we could not time ${count(rows.length - timed.length)}.` : "We could not time any departure here yet.";
  return ch.figure({
    title: info.name,
    note: `${say} Each dot is one departure; the shaded band is 1 minute early to 5 minutes late.`,
    chart: ch.responsive((width) => Plot.plot({
      ariaLabel: `Minutes from the timetable of each departure from ${info.name}, by day`,
      ariaDescription: say,
      style: {background: "transparent", fontSize: "12px", overflow: "visible"},
      width, height: 260, marginLeft: 48, marginBottom: 34,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null, tickFormat: d => d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"}), ticks: 6},
      y: {label: "Minutes late (negative: early)", grid: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.rectY([0], {x1: timed.length ? timed[0].date : new Date(), x2: timed.length ? timed.at(-1).date : new Date(), y1: -1, y2: 5, fill: "var(--status-good)", fillOpacity: 0.13}),
        Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--rule)"}),
        Plot.dot(timed, {x: "date", y: "minutes_late", r: 2.5, fill: "var(--series-1)", fillOpacity: 0.7}),
        Plot.tip(timed, Plot.pointer({x: "date", y: "minutes_late",
          title: d => `${longDate(d.service_date)} ${d.scheduled}\nTrip ${d.trip_id}\n${lateness(d.minutes_late * 60)}`})),
      ],
    }), {height: 260}),
    methods: "arrival-and-departure-times",
  });
}, "The stop chart")
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof tripKey = {
  const recent = [...rows].reverse();
  const tripDays = new Set(index?.days?.slice(-7) ?? []);
  const options = recent.filter(r => tripDays.has(r.service_date));
  if (options.length === 0) return Object.assign(h("p", {class: "empty"}, "No trip from the last 7 days to follow."), {value: null});
  const select = h("select", {id: "trip-pick"}, ...options.map(r =>
    h("option", {value: `${r.service_date}|${r.trip_id}`}, `${longDate(r.service_date)}, scheduled ${r.scheduled} (trip ${r.trip_id})`)));
  const box = h("div", {class: "picker route-picker"}, h("label", {for: "trip-pick", class: "picker-label"}, "Follow a trip"), select);
  box.value = select.value;
  select.addEventListener("change", () => { box.value = select.value; box.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true})); });
  return box;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
guard(() => {
  if (!tripKey) return html``;
  const [date, trip] = tripKey.split("|");
  return (async () => {
    const day = await json(`data/views/trips/${date}.json`);
    const stops = day?.trips?.[trip];
    if (!stops) return emptyNote("unavailable", "This trip");
    const names = Object.fromEntries(stopList.map(s => [s.stop_id, s.name]));
    const c = day.columns;
    const list = stops.map(r => Object.fromEntries(c.map((k, i) => [k, r[i]])));
    return ch.table(list, {
      caption: `Trip ${trip} on ${longDate(date)}, stop by stop`,
      columns: [
        {key: "stop_sequence", label: "Stop", format: (v, r) => `${v}. ${names[r.stop_id] ?? r.stop_id}${r.is_timepoint ? " (timepoint)" : ""}`},
        {key: "scheduled_departure", label: "Scheduled", format: (v, r) => v ?? r.scheduled_arrival ?? "–"},
        {key: "departure", label: "Left", format: (v, r) => v ?? r.arrival ?? "–"},
        {key: "report_source", label: "Timed from", format: v => v ? SOURCES[v] ?? v : "–"},
      ],
    });
  })();
}, "The trip view")
```

<details class="more"><summary>Every departure from this stop</summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
guard(() => rows.length === 0 ? emptyNote("unavailable", "The departures") : ch.table([...rows].reverse(), {
  caption: `Departures from ${info?.name ?? "this stop"}`,
  columns: [
    {key: "service_date", label: "Day", format: v => longDate(v)},
    {key: "scheduled", label: "Scheduled"},
    {key: "minutes_late", label: "Minutes late", align: "right", format: v => v == null ? "–" : v.toFixed(1)},
    {key: "result", label: "Result", format: v => RESULTS[v] ?? v},
    {key: "report_source", label: "Timed from", format: v => v ? SOURCES[v] ?? v : "–"},
    {key: "trip_id", label: "Trip"},
  ],
}), "The departures table")
```
